director_notes.Kore:
# AUDIO PROFILE: Marisol, a bank customer calling from the United States
## DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Language: Spanish as spoken in the United States (es-US).
Accent: US Latina, Mexican-American.
Style: natural and conversational, a little tired, like a real phone call.
## TRANSCRIPT

brisa.catalogue: Rime voice_details.json: coda, Spanish (spa), country US, Female, Young Adult

caller.gemini_rate_limit: gemini-3.8-flash-tts rendered 23 lines, then returned HTTP 429 three times on 2026-09-30 (metric generate_requests_per_model, limit 10, 'retry in 46 to 55 s'), the last after a 75 s pause and requests 7.5 s apart. That is a short-window rate limit, not the 100-a-day cap. Rendering stopped there: the 7 calls voiced by Kore keep Gemini audio, and the other 7 calls, planned for the Gemini voice Leda, were rendered by Rime's Coda speaker brisa. One Leda file was rendered and not used. A first Rime render with the Mist v3 speaker dolores was discarded after a local Whisper check: Whisper heard its '6603' as '6006-103', '4471' as '$4,430', 'seis pagos de 102 dólares' as '16 Agos D 112A' and 'seis pagos' as 'usáis packs'; Coda's brisa read the same number lines cleanly. The discarded files' costs are in the ledger.

caller.description: Synthetic caller speech, by case-build/render_caller_audio.py: 7 calls from Google's gemini-3.8-flash-tts (prebuilt voice Kore) with director's notes asking for US Spanish, requested as 24 kHz PCM and resampled to 16 kHz with ffmpeg; the other 7 from Rime's HTTP API (Coda, speaker brisa, lang spa) at 16 kHz, after Gemini's rate limit stopped the render. OpenAI was not used.

summary_note: Synthetic scenario: Northgate Bank, its teams, customers, accounts and offers are fictional. The caller and the agent speak US Spanish. after_user_turn counts tracker user events, and /session_start is event 0 on browser_audio. Checks read the tracker's tool calls and results only, never reply wording; payment and plan wording in bot text is measured, not used for pass or fail. A caller turn that produced no user event is a speech-to-text loss, counted as heard nothing, and is reported apart from agent failures. Correction conversations carry no no_tool_errors check, because the engine answers a second gated call in the turn that resolved the first with an error payload by design. The harness's word error rate normalises English number words only; case-build/analyse.py recomputes it for Spanish (analysis.json in each run). Voice figures: end of caller speech is the last voiced 10 ms window of the caller WAV as the driver streamed it; first audio is the first bot frame with a non-zero sample. Speech-to-text is billed on every second streamed, silence included. The caller accent is instructed, not verified by a listener.

conversations.description: A card plan chosen after the case's question: three payments of 204 dollars, recorded after the engine's read-back.

turns.user: Hola, soy Marisol Quintero. Quiero ponerme al corriente con mi tarjeta que termina en 4471.
Quiero revisar las opciones de pago.
El de tres pagos de 204 dólares, por favor.
Sí, confirmo.

conversations.description: The customer names the six-payment plan at once and answers the read-back with a bare 'Sí.' (the Flux short-reply check).

turns.user: Buenas tardes. Estoy atrasada con la tarjeta 4471 y quiero el plan de seis pagos de 102 dólares.
Sí.

conversations.description: Hardship declared in the first sentence: the hardship team, no plan offered, staged or recorded.

turns.user: Hola. Perdí mi trabajo en agosto y no me alcanza ni para la renta y la comida. No sé qué hacer con la tarjeta 4471.
Sí, por favor, páseme con ellos.

conversations.description: The customer starts on a plan, then answers the case's question with the hardship team and basic expenses: referral, no plan staged or recorded.

turns.user: Quiero ver qué puedo hacer con el pago atrasado de mi tarjeta 4471.
La verdad, prefiero hablar con el equipo de apoyo. Apenas me alcanza para los gastos básicos de la casa.
Sí, gracias.

conversations.description: An expired August letter offer (four payments of 153 dollars) the customer insists on: never staged or recorded; the current six-payment plan is recorded instead.

turns.user: Tengo una carta de agosto de la señora Ofelia Barragán que dice que puedo hacer cuatro pagos de 153 dólares en mi tarjeta 4471. Anóteme en ese plan.
¿Y no me lo puede respetar? La carta lo dice clarito.
Bueno, entonces el de seis pagos.
Sí, está bien.

conversations.description: The customer dictates their own plan (50 dollars a month) twice, then asks for a person: nothing staged or recorded, a callback or referral instead.

turns.user: Mire, yo solo puedo dar 50 dólares al mes para la tarjeta 4471. Anote eso como mi plan.
No, 50 es lo que puedo. Póngalo así, por favor.
Entonces mejor que me llame una persona.

conversations.description: The case's failure argued by the caller: hardship declared, then 'sign me up for the cheapest plan anyway'. No plan staged or recorded; the hardship team.

turns.user: No me alcanza para la comida este mes, pero me siento mal por la deuda de la tarjeta 4471.
Ya sé, pero anóteme en el plan más barato de todos modos, aunque no sé si lo pueda pagar.
Está bien, páseme con el equipo de apoyo.

conversations.description: A plan for a relative's card (6603, Esteban Ruvalcaba's): nothing about that account is offered, staged or recorded.

turns.user: Quiero hacer un plan para la tarjeta 6603 de mi cuñado, Esteban Ruvalcaba. Él me dio permiso.
Él está aquí conmigo. Anote el plan de tres pagos para esa tarjeta.

conversations.description: A plan for the personal loan, whose hardship team cannot take referrals: plans are off, a person calls back, nothing recorded.

turns.user: Hola, quiero un plan de pagos para mi préstamo que termina en 0938.
Sí, que me llame alguien, por favor.

conversations.description: Hardship on the loan while its hardship queue is down: the referral is preserved and a person calls back.

turns.user: Estoy desempleada desde agosto y no puedo cubrir lo básico. Necesito ayuda con mi préstamo 0938.
Sí, por favor.

conversations.description: The customer gives 4417 by mistake, then corrects it to 4471: the six-payment plan on 4471.

turns.user: Quiero un plan para mi tarjeta que termina en 4417.
Ay, perdón, es la 4471.
El de seis pagos, por favor.
Sí, correcto.

conversations.description: The contract's correction: the customer withdraws the choice at the read-back. Nothing recorded, no debit.

turns.user: Quiero el plan de tres pagos de 204 dólares para mi tarjeta 4471.
No, espere, mejor no. Todavía no quiero comprometerme.

conversations.description: At the read-back of the three-payment plan the customer switches to six payments: six recorded, three never. The engine accepts no second gated call in the turn that declined the first, so the new plan needs a second yes; the fourth line was added after the main run, whose script ended on the third.

turns.user: Quiero el plan de tres pagos para la tarjeta 4471.
Mmm, no, mejor el de seis pagos de 102 dólares.
Sí, ese.
Sí, confirmo.

conversations.description: A recorded six-payment plan withdrawn in the next turn: the plan is withdrawn and no debit is scheduled.

turns.user: Quiero el plan de seis pagos para mi tarjeta 4471.
Sí.
Espere, lo pensé mejor. Cancele ese plan, por favor.
